detailed_descriptions.en: We are Launching into Early Access on October 28th! Everlast: Undying Tale is a love letter to MMO classics in an Action RPG Package. MMO-Lite with 100 player servers Skill based progression Fantasy story and quests Hand placed open world Shared Events Set out into a colorful fantasy world filled with unique areas, strange characters, and dangerous creatures. Build your character by using the skills you want to improve. Fight, gather, craft, fish, explore, collect loot, and put what you learn to use as the story unfolds. Play completely solo, privately with a few friends, or join a larger public world with up to 100 other players. A STORYBOOK TALE The rise of the undying, mysterious strangers with terrifying powers, tales of cowardice and heroics, and more than a few laughs await you on your journey through the world of Everlast: Undying Tale. Play your part in stopping the surge of undying through deeds, both small and mighty. Reveal the secrets of the world, and of your newfound curse, from a memorable cast of characters. Convene with the dead, track down arcane items for friendly monsters, or help townsfolk with simple tasks in the daily lives of running their farms and shops. Discover the magic of a brightly themed, yet slightly macabre adventure that spans from one corner of the world to the next. EXPLORE A BRIGHT OPEN WORLD Discover a vast and bright fantasy realm featuring a variety of landscapes to explore. From the bustling capital of Kal Crossing to the dismal Southern Swamps, across the depths of the Abyss to the top of a great mountain at the center of a dense forest, there are hidden places and points of interest that will help you on your journey. Take your time, wander off the beaten path, and find new ways to grow. MASTER YOUR SKILLS Progress your character through leveling skills such as woodworking, occultism, fishing, and much more. Our Character progression is largely inspired by classic MMO games, but we've ensured that progress in our game occurs much more quickly, allowing you to see clear results in your progress every time you login and play. Use the skills you master to improve your gear and more effectively gather resources, engage in combat, and progress through the story. SHARED DYNAMIC EVENTS Work together for special events and tasks, and to help breathe life back into a world that has fallen into ruin. Ranging from massive harvests to epic battles, our server wide events allow for everyone to contribute as much or as little as they want. These events are player activated and will display as shared events on the in-game map and quest tracker. Additionally, we have a different set of server wide events that anyone can contribute to at any time. These are called "Desolate Zones" and repairing them will help to rebuild the world that you are playing on permanently. This offers benefits back to the player such as ideal depositing or gathering locations, services such as cooking or crafting, or making the world easier to traverse. LOVINGLY CRAFTED Everlast: Undying Tale is built from the ground up by a small, passionate team of engineers, artists, and musicians. This is the first game from our studio, and we have poured our hearts into bringing it from a distant dream to a vibrant reality. We hope that love and care shines through in every moment, both big and small.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
We are Launching into Early Access on October 28th!

Everlast: Undying Tale is a love letter to MMO classics in an Action RPG Package.   

  • MMO-Lite with 100 player servers 

  • Skill based progression 

  • Fantasy story and quests 

  • Hand placed open world 

  • Shared Events 

Set out into a colorful fantasy world filled with unique areas, strange characters, and dangerous creatures. Build your character by using the skills you want to improve. Fight, gather, craft, fish, explore, collect loot, and put what you learn to use as the story unfolds. Play completely solo, privately with a few friends, or join a larger public world with up to 100 other players. 

A STORYBOOK TALE   
The rise of the undying, mysterious strangers with terrifying powers, tales of cowardice and heroics, and more than a few laughs await you on your journey through the world of Everlast: Undying Tale.  
 
Play your part in stopping the surge of undying through deeds, both small and mighty. Reveal the secrets of the world, and of your newfound curse, from a memorable cast of characters. Convene with the dead, track down arcane items for friendly monsters, or help townsfolk with simple tasks in the daily lives of running their farms and shops.  
 
Discover the magic of a brightly themed, yet slightly macabre adventure that spans from one corner of the world to the next. 

EXPLORE A BRIGHT OPEN WORLD 
Discover a vast and bright fantasy realm featuring a variety of landscapes to explore.  
From the bustling capital of Kal Crossing to the dismal Southern Swamps, across the depths of the Abyss to the top of a great mountain at the center of a dense forest, there are hidden places and points of interest that will help you on your journey.  Take your time, wander off the beaten path, and find new ways to grow.  

MASTER YOUR SKILLS 
Progress your character through leveling skills such as woodworking, occultism, fishing, and much more. Our Character progression is largely inspired by classic MMO games, but we've ensured that progress in our game occurs much more quickly, allowing you to see clear results in your progress every time you login and play. Use the skills you master to improve your gear and more effectively gather resources, engage in combat, and progress through the story. 

SHARED DYNAMIC EVENTS 
Work together for special events and tasks, and to help breathe life back into a world that has fallen into ruin.    

 
Ranging from massive harvests to epic battles, our server wide events allow for everyone to contribute as much or as little as they want. These events are player activated and will display as shared events on the in-game map and quest tracker.  

 
Additionally, we have a different set of server wide events that anyone can contribute to at any time. These are called "Desolate Zones" and repairing them will help to rebuild the world that you are playing on permanently. This offers benefits back to the player such as ideal depositing or gathering locations, services such as cooking or crafting, or making the world easier to traverse. 

LOVINGLY CRAFTED 
Everlast: Undying Tale is built from the ground up by a small, passionate team of engineers, artists, and musicians. This is the first game from our studio, and we have poured our hearts into bringing it from a distant dream to a vibrant reality. We hope that love and care shines through in every moment, both big and small.
